_doc: Everything Graph R5 build-plan step 1 (datacore/EVERYTHING_GRAPH.md). Operator/owner strings from datacore/sites/strategic_sites.json (all sites) and datacore/powerplants/us_power_plants.json (top-100-by-capacity_mw plants) mapped to public tickers, hand-verified against SEC filings / company investor-relations pages via live search 2026-07-05. RAW reference data (per the graph's own RAW-vs-SIGNAL rule): asserts a relationship with provenance, no predictive claim. Unmapped entries (government/municipal/federal authorities, privately held merchant generators, fragmented joint ventures) are honest gaps, never guessed tickers — corporate structures change (subsidiaries are sold, spun off, or taken private; this build already caught two registry entries stale for that exact reason), so re-verify before trading on any inference built atop this table.
